items.title: Committed pilot campaign runner emitting RUN-RECORD-conformant arm-run directories
items.context: Create experiments/experience-ablation/run-pilot.mjs (+ optional thin session-guard reuse) adapting the identity-keyed campaign-resume pattern from the recovery powered scratch: enumerate (fixture x arm) cells from the generated corpus manifest + committed run-order seed, skip cells whose run dir already has a terminal run.json (resume), and per cell: copy fixture workspace into a fresh mkdtemp non-git root, execute the host task under LATTICE_EXPERIMENT_ID/<arm> env, capture the run-scoped activity.jsonl slice and post-run workspace, and write run.json with every RUN-RECORD.md required field (experimentId, arm, hostId, storeRoot, timings, commandCount, doneReached, validationPass). Dry-run mode (--plan) prints the cell plan without executing. The runner never writes to the production .lattice/learning store.
items.userSees: node experiments/experience-ablation/run-pilot.mjs --plan prints a cell table (fixtureId x arm, pending/done counts) and exits 0; after a real cell runs, the run dir contains run.json + activity.jsonl + workspace/ and node experiments/experience-ablation/score.mjs --fixture=<f> --run=<r> emits a valid score record with voided absent

happy.desc: --plan prints the cell table (fixtureId x arm, pending/done) and a completed smoke cell yields a run dir score.mjs accepts with voided absent

edge.desc: Resume: re-invoking after interruption skips terminal cells only (identity-keyed), no double execution; selfcheck proves it hermetically with a stub host

adversarial.desc: Isolation precondition: runner asserts resolvedLearningRoot is the mkdtemp root before host execution and aborts if leakage-audit has not passed for the corpus

verificationEvidence.note: --plan printed the cell table in seeded run order (4 cells: fx-bba8fe78-0/fx-04ea3882-0 x treatment/control, all pending, totals line 4 cells 0 done 4 pending, leakage-audit: PASS line), exit 0. Smoke cell coverage: run-pilot-selfcheck.mjs case (3) --smoke produced runs/<fixtureId>__<arm>/ with run.json (all RUN-RECORD required fields, commandCount=1, doneReached/validationPass true) + activity.jsonl + workspace/; node score.mjs --fixture --run exited 0 with voided=false voidReason=null, taskId bound to the armRunId.

Hermetic stub host, zero tokens. Case (4): second invocation printed 1 skipped / 1 executed / 0 still pending and the skipped cells run.json stayed byte-identical (no double execution); progress jsonl gained the cell_skip row (append-only); third invocation printed 2 skipped / 0 executed. Identity key = (experimentId, fixtureId, arm) via terminal run.json detection. Full selfcheck: 24/24 PASS, rerun stable (exit 0 twice).

Case (5): with --scratchDir inside a git checkout the runner spawned observability_snapshot --json in the isolated cwd, saw resolvedLearningRoot escape to the git toplevel, exited 1 with store-isolation assertion failed BEFORE host execution (stub marker file untouched, no run.json, cell_abort row on the progress ledger). Case (2): missing leakage-audit.jsonl and a pass:false row both refuse with exit 1 naming the audit/fixture before any host run; probe env strips LATTICE_PROJECT_ROOT (case 3 ran with it poisoned at the production repo and still resolved the mkdtemp root).

items.title: Mechanical fixture-leakage audit over the generated corpus
items.context: Create experiments/experience-ablation/leakage-audit.mjs: for every fixture in a generated corpus, scan workspace/ + prompt.md against the LEAKAGE_STRIP_LIST markers from trap-templates.mjs (trap-class names, lesson signature phrases, answer-stating sentences, executable residue oracles) and assert reference-bad/reference-good/oracle.mjs are outside workspace/; write leakage-audit.jsonl rows {fixtureId, checks, pass} and exit nonzero on any leak. This is the plan section 9 last-row audit and an M6 pilot exit criterion.
items.userSees: node experiments/experience-ablation/leakage-audit.mjs --corpus=<dir> prints per-fixture PASS lines ending leakage-audit: all fixtures clean (N fixtures) with exit 0 and writes leakage-audit.jsonl

happy.desc: Clean generated corpus -> per-fixture PASS lines ending leakage-audit: all fixtures clean (N fixtures), exit 0, leakage-audit.jsonl written

edge.desc: A deliberately poisoned fixture (strip-list marker injected into workspace) -> nonzero exit naming the fixture and marker

adversarial.desc: Audit asserts oracle.mjs/reference payloads live outside workspace/ and prompt.md never names the trap class

verificationEvidence.note: Selftest clean phase: generator corpus (9 fixtures, perClass=1) audited via spawned CLI -> exit 0, 9 PASS lines, final line leakage-audit: all fixtures clean (9 fixtures), leakage-audit.jsonl rows {fixtureId, checks, pass} all pass and sorted. Also manually ran --corpus on an 18-fixture demo corpus: sorted PASS lines + clean summary + jsonl written, exit 0.

Selftest poison phase: copied the clean corpus, injected strip-list marker memory pack into fx-0d5b8958-0 workspace/config.json, spawned CLI on the copy -> exit 1, stderr LEAK line names fixture fx-0d5b8958-0, the marker (quoted memory pack) and the poisoned file; jsonl row has pass=false with workspaceMarkers check failed while unpoisoned fixtures still pass.

Per-fixture checks hiddenArtifactsOutsideWorkspace (oracle.mjs + reference-good/ + reference-bad/ must exist at fixture root and never appear under workspace/**, verified by recursive walk of workspace path segments) and promptOmitsTrapClass (prompt.md must not contain the task.json trapClass, case-insensitive) are enforced on every audited fixture; both checks pass=true in every jsonl row of the 9-fixture selftest corpus and the 18-fixture demo corpus, and any hit fails the fixture with a LEAK line + nonzero exit.

items.title: Protocol freeze and pilot execution: both arms, isolation asserted, scorer replay agreement
items.context: Generate the pilot corpus (>=5 fixtures per trap group: 6 in-store classes + 2 held-out + clean), freeze protocol.json via node experiments/experience-ablation/protocol.mjs freeze (fixture manifest + run-order seed + memory snapshot hash), build the pair ledger, then execute the pilot with run-pilot.mjs: every fixture through BOTH arms, plus enough additional control-arm fault-task runs to reach >=15 (plan section 7 freeze rule precondition). Score every run dir with score.mjs into score-records.jsonl under .lattice/experiments/experience-ablation/<experimentId>/. Assertions: zero voided records (store isolation held), re-scoring every archived run dir a second time is byte-identical (scorer agreement on replay), control-arm records have memoryPackShown=false and treatment true.
items.userSees: The pilot summary prints: cells completed (fixtures x 2 arms + extra control runs), control-arm fault runs >= 15, voided records 0, replay re-score byte-identical (digest match), score-records.jsonl row count

happy.desc: Pilot summary transcript: all (fixture x 2 arms) cells complete + control-arm fault runs >= 15, score-records.jsonl row count matches

edge.desc: Replay agreement: re-scoring every archived run dir a second time is byte-identical (digest match printed)

adversarial.desc: Zero voided records (store isolation held) and control records show memoryPackShown=false with treatment true; protocol.json validates against the frozen manifest

items.title: Control-arm baseline estimate and powered-N freeze via pilotFreezeCheck
items.context: From the control-arm fault-task score records compute defects/runs and run sample-size.mjs pilotFreezeCheck (Wilson 95% CI; freeze the powered N at the N-maximizing baseline within the CI, p* = 0.5 + mde/2 clamped — the corrected S7 rule; extend the pilot if CI width > 0.30). Record the frozen per-population N + the freeze inputs into the experiment evidence root (e.g. n-freeze.json) referenced by the protocol experimentId, ready for M7. If the observed baseline falls outside the planning band (0.5-0.8), record the recompute per the plan instead of silently proceeding.
items.userSees: The freeze output prints: control fault runs N, defects K, baseline p, Wilson CI [lo, hi], CI width (<= 0.30), N-maximizing baseline p*, frozen powered N per arm, and writes n-freeze.json

happy.desc: Freeze transcript prints control fault runs N, defects K, baseline p, Wilson CI [lo,hi], width <= 0.30, p*, frozen powered N per arm; n-freeze.json written under the experiment evidence root

edge.desc: CI width > 0.30 at intermediate count -> freeze refused and pilot extended (transcript shows the refusal then the post-extension freeze)

adversarial.desc: Frozen N equals sample-size.mjs pilotFreezeCheck output exactly (independent recomputation cross-check), not a hand-derived value

items.title: Experience-delivery prelude and frozen-snapshot materialization in the pilot runner
items.context: CHK-003 smoke discovered the experience-delivery gap: fixture workspaces carry no .lattice/learning store and prompts never invoke the lattice CLI, so in isolated roots BOTH arms would see an empty pack and the experiment would be null by construction. Fix per plan sections 4/9/12: (a) new deterministic snapshot builder (experiments/experience-ablation/snapshot-builder.mjs) emitting a frozen memory-store directory whose lessons cover exactly the six in-store trap classes (and none of the held-out classes; disjointness asserted); protocol.mjs freeze consumes it via --snapshotDir so memorySnapshotHash binds the content. (b) run-pilot.mjs extension: --memorySnapshotDir materialized BYTE-IDENTICALLY into each isolated root learning path on BOTH arms, sha256-verified against protocol.json before host execution and re-verified unchanged after the run (plan section 14 snapshot row). (c) experience-delivery prelude: before host execution invoke the real gated entrypoint (node <cli> session_brief with the experiment env, cwd=isolated workspace) so the pack is computed+logged on both arms via the production M3 mechanism; prepend the rendered pack section to the host prompt ONLY when the entrypoint rendered it (treatment); control prompt stays byte-identical to the raw prompt.md. Update run-pilot-selfcheck to cover: snapshot hash mismatch aborts; treatment prompt contains the pack section while control does not; experience_pack_surfaced appears in both arms run records; snapshot unchanged after run.
items.userSees: run-pilot-selfcheck prints the new PASS cases (snapshot materialized + hash verified, treatment prompt carries the pack section, control prompt byte-identical to prompt.md, surfaced events on both arms) ending ALL PASS; a smoke cell run record shows surfacedMemoryIds non-empty on treatment

verificationEvidence.note: Extended selfcheck ALL PASS (39 checks) twice for determinism. Happy path: snapshot materialized byte-identically on BOTH arms (case 6), treatment host prompt = rendered Memory Runtime Preflight section + raw prompt with surfaced-lesson union covering all six in-store classes (case 7: pb-host-policy/pb-reviewer-lane/pb-stale-doc/pb-deprecated-brand/pb-false-done + les-parent-roadmap), control host prompt byte-identical to fixture prompt.md, experience_pack_surfaced prelude event present in both arms captured slices with frozen-store topHitIds (case 8), run.json binds memorySnapshotHash and memoryPackRendered=true only on treatment.

verificationEvidence.command: env -u LATTICE_PROJECT_ROOT LATTICE_EXPERIMENT_ID=exp-probe LATTICE_EXPERIMENT_ARM=treatment node packages/main/dist/cli.js session_brief (cwd = bare mkdtemp non-git workspace)
verificationEvidence.note: Empirical edge probes against the real built CLI: (1) a story-less isolated root EARLY-RETURNS from session_brief (No active story) with NO pack section and NO event — the frozen snapshot therefore carries a minimal anchor story (story/actives/B-mem0/index.json) which empirically unlocks the production Memory Runtime Preflight render path; (2) the operator machine global store (~/.lattice/dev-memory) leaked entries 9890b83/a4d08a8 into the pack — fixed by pinning LATTICE_GLOBAL_MEMORY_DIR to an empty dir inside the isolated root (pack shows global=none); (3) session_brief creates runtime-memory-pack-cache under .lattice/learning, so post-run snapshot verification hashes exactly the frozen file set (relpath+bytes, hashDirectorySnapshot-compatible), not the whole dir.
